uploadDefaultFiles.description:
Whether to manually upload files through the file system or through the admin page.
Set to false by default, allowing users to upload files directly through the admin page.
If set to true, this will automatically upload a test pdf file with the size based on {@link ReliabilityGenaiTestDataOptions#fileSize}.

fileSize.description: Size of test file to upload when {@link ReliabilityGenaiTestDataOptions#uploadDefaultFiles} is set to true.
